attributes.name: quick-link icon usage
attributes.definition: Whether quick-link items include icons alongside their text labels.

values.definition: Quick links show text labels with no icons.
Quick links pair icons with text labels.
Quick links are icons without text labels.
No quick-link strip or set of quick links on the page.

attributes.name: quick-link item style
attributes.definition: How individual quick-link items are visually presented.

values.definition: Items are bare text labels with no button border or fill.
Items are buttons with an outline border and no solid fill.
Items are buttons with a solid fill.
Items are presented as cards or tiles.

attributes.name: quick-link container background
attributes.definition: The background treatment of the band or strip holding the quick links.

values.definition: Strip is filled with the brand accent colour.
Strip is a dark neutral band.
Strip is a light or white background.
